column1: # Venus Lighthouse Aerie: first confrontation, Sheba's hostage crisis, the Shaman's Rod bargain and first battle.

column3: At last, the moment\nhas come to awaken\nVenus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
With this beacon lit,\nonly two will remain.{end_wait}
No. Jupiter will be\nthe last, as Mars was\nbefore it.{end_wait}
Then Jupiter is the\nfinal obstacle.{end_wait}
Your long pursuit is\nalmost at its end.{end_wait}
Why are you still here,\n{actor_name:5}?{end_wait}
I ordered you to\ngo ahead to the ship.{end_wait}
I sent {actor_name:6} and the\nothers to Idejima.{end_wait}
Then why did you\nreturn here?{end_wait}
I have another promise\nto fulfill.{end_wait}
Yes, {actor_name:7}. Why is\nshe still held here?{end_wait}
You said she would be\nfreed once we entered\nVenus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
So that is why you\ncame back.{end_wait}
You swore not to draw\nanyone else into this.{end_wait}
Because {actor_name:7} is a\nspecial Adept?{end_wait}
You learned something\nfrom the first two\nlighthouses.{end_wait}
Each lighthouse needed\nan Adept of its element.{end_wait}
We have Earth, Fire,\nand Water among us...{pause_20_skippable}\nbut no Wind Adept.{end_wait}
That would explain it{pause_20_skippable}.{end_wait}
Then we need {actor_name:7}\nto enter Jupiter\nLighthouse?{end_wait}
I'm sorry, {actor_name:5}. We\ncannot enter without\na Wind Adept.{end_wait}
Now I see why you\ncannot release {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
You understand more\nthan you once did.{page_break}Now go, {actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
No. I will not leave\n{actor_name:7} behind.{end_wait}
I'm taking {actor_name:7}\nto the ship.{end_wait}
What do you mean,\n{actor_name:5}?{end_wait}
We don't know what the\nbeacon will do. I won't\nleave {actor_name:7} here.{end_wait}
We promised to keep\n{actor_name:7} safe. Don't\nyou trust us?{end_wait}
That's not what I mean...{pause_20_skippable}\nI only want to be\ncertain she's safe.{end_wait}
Don't decide for us,\n{actor_name:5}. You will not\ntake {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
Why not?{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} What?{pause_20_skippable}\nYou don't trust me?{end_wait}
After what you just\ndemanded, how could we\ntrust you with {actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
If we had trusted you,\n{actor_name:7} would be free\nby now.{end_wait}
Come with me, {actor_name:7}.\nI will keep you safe.{end_wait}
Are you prepared to\nfight us for her?{end_wait}
He has already chosen.{page_break}He would not oppose us\nunless he meant to\nsee it through.{end_wait}
If it means protecting\n{actor_name:7} from harm,\nthen I must.{end_wait}
You have seen our\nstrength. You cannot\ndefeat us.{end_wait}
How will you protect\n{actor_name:7}{pause_20_skippable} if you cannot\nprotect yourself?{end_wait}
This defiance is why\nyou were never allowed\nto fight beside us.{end_wait}
Have you learned\nnothing from the road\nthat brought you here?{end_wait}
You are no warrior,\n{actor_name:5}. You cannot\nstand against us.{end_wait}
Enough talk!{pause_20_skippable} Show us\nwhat you can do!{end_wait}
They are turning\nagainst one another\nover {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
But something else\nis happening here...{end_wait}
Saturos and Menardi\nno longer trust {actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
Then this is our\nchance to stop them\nbefore the beacon.{end_wait}
Move now. We must\nstop them from\nlighting the beacon!{end_now}
There's no time left!{pause_20_skippable}\nGo!{end_wait}
Don't falter. If we\nwait, they will light it.{end_wait}
So...{pause_20_skippable} you've come\nto stop us?{end_wait}
Your rebellion has\nbrought this upon us,\n{actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
I don't need anyone\nto rescue me, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
I was about to settle\nthis with Saturos and\nMenardi myself...{page_break}You may watch.{end_wait}
Then you'll witness\nthe full force of\nthis beacon.{end_wait}
But {actor_name:7} has no part\nin your conflict. Let\n{actor_name:7} go!{end_wait}
Quiet!{pause_20_skippable} One more word,\n{actor_name:5}, and both you\nand {actor_name:7} will suffer.{end_wait}
If {actor_name:7} is harmed,\nwe have failed Faran.{end_wait}
We won't let you touch\n{actor_name:7} or {actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
Ah, so you care\nabout {actor_name:7} as well?{end_wait}
Don't worry. We won't\nhurt {actor_name:7}...{pause_20_skippable} if you\nmeet our conditions.{end_wait}
Saturos, what are\nyou doing?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}!{pause_20_skippable} Do you recall\nthe rod linked to\nHesperia?{end_wait}
The Shaman's Rod.\nThe key to Jupiter\nLighthouse.{end_wait}
Those who follow us\ncarry a rod... Is it\nthe same one?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}! Stay there.\nYou can try from\nwhere you stand.{end_wait}
...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}\nPerhaps...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}{end_wait}
Perhaps?{pause_20_skippable} What does\nthat mean? Speak!{end_wait}
We're not shouting!{pause_20_skippable}\nWe need a clear answer.{end_wait}
Their thoughts are\nhidden... I cannot see...{pause_20_skippable}\nbut I think it is.{pause_20_skippable}{end_wait}
There is no point\nmaking her try again.{end_wait}
Do you know what we\nwill demand before we\nspare {actor_name:7}?{end_now}
You are quicker than\nI expected. You have\nguessed our price.{end_wait}
We want the rod that\nopens Jupiter\nLighthouse.{end_wait}
Give us the Shaman's\nRod, and {actor_name:7} will be\nunharmed. Agreed?{end_now}
The Shaman's Rod?{pause_20_skippable}\nIf it keeps {actor_name:7} safe,\nthen take it.{end_wait}
He wants the rod.\nIf that saves {actor_name:7},\nI will surrender it.{end_wait}
What?{pause_20_skippable} But Hammet gave\nthat to you, {actor_name:3}!{end_wait}
Do you care so little\nfor {actor_name:7}'s life?{end_wait}
Then take {text_effect:2}the rod!{reset_text_style}{end_wait}
Well done, Saturos.\nThe Shaman's Rod is\nfinally ours.{end_wait}
To make certain you\nkeep your word to us.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} surrendered\nthe Shaman's Rod.{end_wait}
What do you want\nme to do with it?{end_wait}
Where do you think\nyou're going, {actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
We gave you the rod.\nNow release {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
What are you\ntalking about?{end_wait}
You said you'd free\n{actor_name:7} if we gave\nyou the rod.{end_wait}
We fulfilled our end.\nLet {actor_name:7} go.{end_wait}
You changed the\nagreement?{end_wait}
You misunderstood\nthe terms. That is\nhardly our fault.{end_wait}
Besides, if we let\n{actor_name:7} go, she would\nnever reach home alone.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} cannot get\nback to Lalivero\nalone.{end_wait}
Take {actor_name:7}?{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nNo... I see now.{end_wait}
That's right.{pause_20_skippable} Your\njourney ends here.{end_wait}
Enough!{pause_20_skippable} You are the\nones who will not\nleave this place!{end_wait}
Come then, boy. You\nwill regret standing\nagainst us.{end_wait}
Learn what a master\nFire Adept can do.{end_wait}
We did it.\nThey're beaten.{end_wait}
